propositions: rebar comment silently accepts flag-looking arguments (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, destroying the intended content while exiting with code 0
the command lacks validation to reject positional body arguments beginning with dash, allowing users to accidentally store flag tokens as comments (observed twice in two independent sessions)
surplus positional arguments holding intended values are silently discarded via args[:min_args] slice, compounding data loss when flag-like tokens are stored
the fix must guard all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) against this footgun, not just comment alone
users need a documented escape hatch to store comments that legitimately begin with dash (via -- separator convention)
the implementation chose not to add a real --body-file option; the decision rationale should be documented for future reference
